description: Defines procedures and data structures for selecting and calculating default PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) resources as specified in 3GPP TS38.213, including resource parameter structures, index calculations, and PRB/cyclic shift computations.

classes.name: pucch_default_resource
classes.description: Structure holding parameters for default PUCCH resource configuration, including format, symbol index, symbol count, PRB offset, and cyclic shift indexes.

methods.name: get_pucch_default_resource
methods.description: Returns default PUCCH resource parameters based on a row index and BWP size, following TS38.213 specifications.

methods.name: get_pucch_default_resource_index
methods.description: Calculates the PUCCH resource index based on CCE indices and delta PRI, following TS38.213 Section 9.2.1.

methods.name: get_pucch_default_prb_index
methods.description: Computes the PRB indexes for the first and second hops of the PUCCH resource based on resource index, PRB offset, cyclic shifts, and BWP size.

methods.name: get_pucch_default_cyclic_shift
methods.description: Determines the cyclic shift for a given PUCCH resource index and number of cyclic shifts.
